report.incidentSummary: On 2026-09-23 starting around 09:30 IST (04:00 UTC), users reported mutual fund values and P&L in their portfolios were unchanged from the previous day. Stock holdings were unaffected and dashboards showed no 5xx errors. Investigation revealed that the nightly scheduled nav-import batch on 2026-09-22 at 23:30 IST (18:00 UTC) failed due to an Out-Of-Memory (OOMKilled) crash in market-data-service at 512Mi while staging AMFI feed rows. The transaction rolled back with 0 NAVs committed, and no retry was triggered. portfolio-service fell back to serving the last available NAV from 2026-09-21, leaving mutual fund valuations stale.
report.rootCauseStatement: The nightly mutual fund NAV import job (nav-import) scheduled at 2026-09-22 23:30 IST (18:00 UTC) failed because the market-data-service worker exceeded its 512Mi container memory limit (OOMKilled) while staging 14,302 rows from AMFI's NAVAll.txt file. The database transaction rolled back, committing 0 NAVs, and job-scheduler did not retry the job. Consequently, market-data-service retained stale NAVs dated 2026-09-21 (nav_age_s > 35 hours), causing portfolio-service to fall back to Sept 21 valuations on Sept 23 and leaving mutual fund portfolio values and P&L unchanged.

hypotheses.cause: The nightly nav-import worker in market-data-service was OOMKilled (exceeding its 512Mi memory limit) while staging rows from NAVAll.txt, rolling back the transaction and committing 0 NAVs for 2026-09-22; market-data-service continued serving Sept 21 NAVs.
hypotheses.rationale: Logs directly capture the OOMKilled event at 18:03:24Z, transaction rollback, job failure in job-scheduler without retry, and monotonic rise in nav_age_s to >35 hours. portfolio-service received nav_date=2026-09-21 and used fallback logic to show previous NAVs.

hypotheses.cause: Cache TTL change CHG-48221 on cache at 03:25:00Z caused stale NAVs to be served to portfolio-service.
hypotheses.rationale: Stale NAV lookups and portfolio-service warnings (nav_date=2026-09-21) were active at 02:33Z, nearly an hour before CHG-48221 at 03:25Z. Furthermore, market-data-service itself had no updated NAVs for 2026-09-22, so cache was not hiding fresh data.

hypotheses.cause: External amfi-nav-feed was unavailable or failed to supply the NAV file.
hypotheses.rationale: Logs show market-data-service successfully downloaded NAVAll.txt (2041 KB) from amfi-nav-feed at 18:01:00Z.

hypotheses.cause: portfolio-service deployment regression caused valuation errors or failure to fetch prices.
hypotheses.rationale: portfolio-service valuations succeeded normally with ~0.2% error rate and displayed values steady at ~4,852 Cr; it accurately detected that the NAV date was older than 1 trading day and displayed the fallback NAV.

facts.statement: On 2026-09-22 at 18:00:00Z (23:30 IST), job-scheduler started job nav-import (run_58a35a02).
market-data-service downloaded NAVAll.txt (2041 KB) from amfi-nav-feed at 18:01:00Z and loaded 6,210 of 14,302 rows into staging before memory reached 96% of limit at 18:03:00Z.
At 2026-09-22T18:03:24Z, the nav-import worker was killed (OOMKilled, limit 512Mi), its transaction was rolled back, and 0 NAVs were committed.
job-scheduler logged nav-import failed with exit code 1 at 18:06:00Z, jobs_failed metric spiked to 0.2 count/min, and the job was not retried.
On 2026-09-23 at 02:30:00Z, market-data-service metric nav_age_s was 116,760 seconds (~32.4 hours) and climbed monotonically to 127,260 seconds (~35.4 hours) by 05:25:00Z.
market-data-service served NAV lookups with nav_date=2026-09-21 throughout the evening of 2026-09-22 and the morning of 2026-09-23.
portfolio-service logged warnings as early as 02:33:38Z on 2026-09-23 that fund NAVs were older than 1 trading day (nav_date=2026-09-21) and fell back to displaying the last available NAV.
A configuration change (CHG-48221) was applied to cache at 2026-09-23T03:25:00Z, raising the TTL for the nav keyspace from 3,600s to 21,600s.

portfolio-service error rate (~0.2%), valuation errors (~1/min), displayed value (~4,852 Cr), and api-gateway /v1/portfolio error rate (~0.26%) remained normal because portfolio-service gracefully fell back to the Sept 21 NAV.

inferences.statement: Because nav-import committed 0 NAVs on 2026-09-22, market-data-service only had NAVs dated 2026-09-21, causing portfolio-service to display Sept 21 NAVs on Sept 23 and leaving mutual fund values and P&L frozen.
Dashboards remained green because portfolio-service gracefully falls back to displaying the last available NAV rather than failing requests with 5xx or valuation errors.

The cache TTL increase CHG-48221 at 03:25:00Z did not cause the incident because the staleness began before the change, though it would extend the staleness duration once fresh NAVs are committed unless flushed.

assumptions.statement: The total row count of AMFI NAVAll.txt (14,302 rows, 2,041 KB) or worker baseline memory usage gradually increased until staging 6,210 rows exceeded the 512Mi container limit.

timeline.event: Last successful nav-import committed mutual fund NAVs with nav_date=2026-09-21.
job-scheduler triggered scheduled nightly job nav-import (run_58a35a02).
market-data-service downloaded NAVAll.txt (2041 KB, 14302 rows) from amfi-nav-feed.
nav-import loaded 6210 of 14302 rows into staging; worker memory reached 96% of limit.
nav-import worker killed by OOM killer (OOMKilled, limit 512Mi); transaction rolled back, 0 NAVs committed.
job-scheduler jobs_failed metric spiked to 0.2 count/min.
job-scheduler marked job nav-import failed (run_58a35a02) with exit code 1; no retry was scheduled.
market-data-service metric nav_age_s reached 116,760s (~32.4 hours) and continued rising.
portfolio-service logged warnings for holdings with nav_date=2026-09-21 older than 1 trading day and fell back to displaying the last available NAV.
Config change CHG-48221 increased cache TTL for nav keyspace from 3600s to 21600s.
Users began reporting unchanged mutual fund portfolio values and P&L around stock market open (09:30 IST).

confidence.rationale: Direct application logs from market-data-service and job-scheduler document the exact OOMKilled failure, rollback, and exit code 1 of nav-import on 2026-09-22 at 18:03:24Z, and metrics confirm nav_age_s reached over 35 hours without new NAV commits. Ruling out the cache TTL change is corroborated by timing and market-data-service logs showing stale NAVs pre-dating the change.

gaps.description: Log retention begins at 2026-09-22T16:00:00Z, so memory telemetry for previous successful runs of nav-import (e.g. 2026-09-21) could not be compared.
gaps.impact: Negligible; the OOMKilled error and transaction rollback are directly recorded in the available logs for the 2026-09-22 run.

recommendedActions.action: Increase the memory limit for the market-data-service nav-import worker (e.g. from 512Mi to 1Gi or 2Gi) and manually trigger nav-import for 2026-09-22/2026-09-23.
recommendedActions.rationale: The job failed because 512Mi was insufficient to stage 14,302 rows of NAVAll.txt. Increasing memory and re-running will commit the latest NAVs to market-data-service.
recommendedActions.verification: Check job-scheduler logs for nav-import completion (exit code 0), and verify market-data-service nav_age_s drops from >127,000s to <3,600s.

recommendedActions.action: Flush or invalidate the nav keyspace in cache after nav-import completes.
recommendedActions.rationale: CHG-48221 increased the nav keyspace TTL to 21,600s (6h), which would delay users seeing newly committed NAVs unless the cache is explicitly invalidated.
recommendedActions.verification: Verify via portfolio-service logs that holdings valuations use the latest nav_date and warnings cease.

recommendedActions.action: Add alerting on market-data-service nav_age_s > 64,800s (18 hours) and job-scheduler jobs_failed > 0 for critical scheduled jobs.
recommendedActions.rationale: The nav-import failure at 18:03 UTC went undetected for ~10 hours because no alert was triggered on job failure or NAV staleness.
recommendedActions.verification: Inspect alerting rules to confirm active alerts on nav_age_s and job failure metrics.

recommendedActions.action: Configure automated retry policies and dead-letter notifications in job-scheduler for nav-import.
recommendedActions.rationale: When nav-import exited with code 1, no automated retry was scheduled, leaving the system in a stale state until the next day's run.
recommendedActions.verification: Verify job-scheduler job definition includes retry attempts (e.g. retries: 2, backoff: 15m).

recommendedActions.action: Refactor market-data-service NAV parsing to stream or batch insert rows rather than loading the entire file into an in-memory staging table.
recommendedActions.rationale: Batch/stream processing ensures memory consumption remains bounded regardless of growth in the AMFI scheme catalog.
recommendedActions.verification: Benchmark nav-import with synthetic large files under constrained memory limits and confirm memory stays well below limits.

# Investigation report: Mutual fund values not updating

**Outcome:** conclusive · **Stop reason:** completed · **Confidence:** 0.95 · **Written by:** baseline agent

## Summary
On 2026-09-23 starting around 09:30 IST (04:00 UTC), users reported mutual fund values and P&L in their portfolios were unchanged from the previous day. Stock holdings were unaffected and dashboards showed no 5xx errors. Investigation revealed that the nightly scheduled nav-import batch on 2026-09-22 at 23:30 IST (18:00 UTC) failed due to an Out-Of-Memory (OOMKilled) crash in market-data-service at 512Mi while staging AMFI feed rows. The transaction rolled back with 0 NAVs committed, and no retry was triggered. portfolio-service fell back to serving the last available NAV from 2026-09-21, leaving mutual fund valuations stale.

**Root cause:** The nightly mutual fund NAV import job (nav-import) scheduled at 2026-09-22 23:30 IST (18:00 UTC) failed because the market-data-service worker exceeded its 512Mi container memory limit (OOMKilled) while staging 14,302 rows from AMFI's NAVAll.txt file. The database transaction rolled back, committing 0 NAVs, and job-scheduler did not retry the job. Consequently, market-data-service retained stale NAVs dated 2026-09-21 (nav_age_s > 35 hours), causing portfolio-service to fall back to Sept 21 valuations on Sept 23 and leaving mutual fund portfolio values and P&L unchanged.

## Hypotheses
1. **The nightly nav-import worker in market-data-service was OOMKilled (exceeding its 512Mi memory limit) while staging rows from NAVAll.txt, rolling back the transaction and committing 0 NAVs for 2026-09-22; market-data-service continued serving Sept 21 NAVs.** — `market-data-service`, capacity_saturation, confidence 0.95, supported
   - Supporting: [ev_3, ev_5, ev_6, ev_7, ev_8, ev_9] · Contradicting: none
   - Logs directly capture the OOMKilled event at 18:03:24Z, transaction rollback, job failure in job-scheduler without retry, and monotonic rise in nav_age_s to >35 hours. portfolio-service received nav_date=2026-09-21 and used fallback logic to show previous NAVs.
2. **Cache TTL change CHG-48221 on cache at 03:25:00Z caused stale NAVs to be served to portfolio-service.** — `cache`, config_change, confidence 0.05, ruled_out
   - Supporting: [ev_1] · Contradicting: [ev_3, ev_5, ev_8]
   - Stale NAV lookups and portfolio-service warnings (nav_date=2026-09-21) were active at 02:33Z, nearly an hour before CHG-48221 at 03:25Z. Furthermore, market-data-service itself had no updated NAVs for 2026-09-22, so cache was not hiding fresh data.
3. **External amfi-nav-feed was unavailable or failed to supply the NAV file.** — `amfi-nav-feed`, upstream_dependency_degradation, confidence 0.00, ruled_out
   - Supporting: none · Contradicting: [ev_5]
   - Logs show market-data-service successfully downloaded NAVAll.txt (2041 KB) from amfi-nav-feed at 18:01:00Z.
4. **portfolio-service deployment regression caused valuation errors or failure to fetch prices.** — `portfolio-service`, deployment_regression, confidence 0.00, ruled_out
   - Supporting: none · Contradicting: [ev_8, ev_14, ev_15, ev_16, ev_20]
   - portfolio-service valuations succeeded normally with ~0.2% error rate and displayed values steady at ~4,852 Cr; it accurately detected that the NAV date was older than 1 trading day and displayed the fallback NAV.

## Facts
- On 2026-09-22 at 18:00:00Z (23:30 IST), job-scheduler started job nav-import (run_58a35a02). [ev_5]
- market-data-service downloaded NAVAll.txt (2041 KB) from amfi-nav-feed at 18:01:00Z and loaded 6,210 of 14,302 rows into staging before memory reached 96% of limit at 18:03:00Z. [ev_5]
- At 2026-09-22T18:03:24Z, the nav-import worker was killed (OOMKilled, limit 512Mi), its transaction was rolled back, and 0 NAVs were committed. [ev_5]
- job-scheduler logged nav-import failed with exit code 1 at 18:06:00Z, jobs_failed metric spiked to 0.2 count/min, and the job was not retried. [ev_5, ev_6, ev_7]
- On 2026-09-23 at 02:30:00Z, market-data-service metric nav_age_s was 116,760 seconds (~32.4 hours) and climbed monotonically to 127,260 seconds (~35.4 hours) by 05:25:00Z. [ev_3]
- market-data-service served NAV lookups with nav_date=2026-09-21 throughout the evening of 2026-09-22 and the morning of 2026-09-23. [ev_5, ev_8, ev_9]
- portfolio-service logged warnings as early as 02:33:38Z on 2026-09-23 that fund NAVs were older than 1 trading day (nav_date=2026-09-21) and fell back to displaying the last available NAV. [ev_8]
- A configuration change (CHG-48221) was applied to cache at 2026-09-23T03:25:00Z, raising the TTL for the nav keyspace from 3,600s to 21,600s. [ev_1]
- portfolio-service error rate (~0.2%), valuation errors (~1/min), displayed value (~4,852 Cr), and api-gateway /v1/portfolio error rate (~0.26%) remained normal because portfolio-service gracefully fell back to the Sept 21 NAV. [ev_14, ev_15, ev_16, ev_20]

## Inferences
- Because nav-import committed 0 NAVs on 2026-09-22, market-data-service only had NAVs dated 2026-09-21, causing portfolio-service to display Sept 21 NAVs on Sept 23 and leaving mutual fund values and P&L frozen. [ev_3, ev_5, ev_8]
- Dashboards remained green because portfolio-service gracefully falls back to displaying the last available NAV rather than failing requests with 5xx or valuation errors. [ev_14, ev_15, ev_16, ev_20]
- The cache TTL increase CHG-48221 at 03:25:00Z did not cause the incident because the staleness began before the change, though it would extend the staleness duration once fresh NAVs are committed unless flushed. [ev_1, ev_8]

## Assumptions
- The total row count of AMFI NAVAll.txt (14,302 rows, 2,041 KB) or worker baseline memory usage gradually increased until staging 6,210 rows exceeded the 512Mi container limit.

## Timeline
- **2026-09-21T18:04:00.000Z** Last successful nav-import committed mutual fund NAVs with nav_date=2026-09-21. [ev_3, ev_5]
- **2026-09-22T18:00:00.000Z** job-scheduler triggered scheduled nightly job nav-import (run_58a35a02). [ev_5]
- **2026-09-22T18:01:00.000Z** market-data-service downloaded NAVAll.txt (2041 KB, 14302 rows) from amfi-nav-feed. [ev_5]
- **2026-09-22T18:03:00.000Z** nav-import loaded 6210 of 14302 rows into staging; worker memory reached 96% of limit. [ev_5]
- **2026-09-22T18:03:24.000Z** nav-import worker killed by OOM killer (OOMKilled, limit 512Mi); transaction rolled back, 0 NAVs committed. [ev_5]
- **2026-09-22T18:05:00.000Z** job-scheduler jobs_failed metric spiked to 0.2 count/min. [ev_7]
- **2026-09-22T18:06:00.000Z** job-scheduler marked job nav-import failed (run_58a35a02) with exit code 1; no retry was scheduled. [ev_5, ev_6]
- **2026-09-23T02:30:00.000Z** market-data-service metric nav_age_s reached 116,760s (~32.4 hours) and continued rising. [ev_3]
- **2026-09-23T02:33:38.422Z** portfolio-service logged warnings for holdings with nav_date=2026-09-21 older than 1 trading day and fell back to displaying the last available NAV. [ev_8]
- **2026-09-23T03:25:00.000Z** Config change CHG-48221 increased cache TTL for nav keyspace from 3600s to 21600s. [ev_1]
- **2026-09-23T04:00:00.000Z** Users began reporting unchanged mutual fund portfolio values and P&L around stock market open (09:30 IST). [ev_8, ev_9]

## Confidence
0.95: Direct application logs from market-data-service and job-scheduler document the exact OOMKilled failure, rollback, and exit code 1 of nav-import on 2026-09-22 at 18:03:24Z, and metrics confirm nav_age_s reached over 35 hours without new NAV commits. Ruling out the cache TTL change is corroborated by timing and market-data-service logs showing stale NAVs pre-dating the change.

## Gaps
- Log retention begins at 2026-09-22T16:00:00Z, so memory telemetry for previous successful runs of nav-import (e.g. 2026-09-21) could not be compared. (impact: Negligible; the OOMKilled error and transaction rollback are directly recorded in the available logs for the 2026-09-22 run.)

## Tool failures
- get_changes {"from":"2026-09-13T00:00:00.000Z","to":"2026-09-23T05:30:00.000Z","services":["market-data-service","job-scheduler"]}: invalid_input: time range is 245.5 h; the maximum is 240 h. Narrow it. (1 attempts)

## Recommended actions (not executed)
- **[now]** Increase the memory limit for the market-data-service nav-import worker (e.g. from 512Mi to 1Gi or 2Gi) and manually trigger nav-import for 2026-09-22/2026-09-23. [ev_5]
  - Why: The job failed because 512Mi was insufficient to stage 14,302 rows of NAVAll.txt. Increasing memory and re-running will commit the latest NAVs to market-data-service.
  - Verify: Check job-scheduler logs for nav-import completion (exit code 0), and verify market-data-service nav_age_s drops from >127,000s to <3,600s.
- **[now]** Flush or invalidate the nav keyspace in cache after nav-import completes. [ev_1, ev_8]
  - Why: CHG-48221 increased the nav keyspace TTL to 21,600s (6h), which would delay users seeing newly committed NAVs unless the cache is explicitly invalidated.
  - Verify: Verify via portfolio-service logs that holdings valuations use the latest nav_date and warnings cease.
- **[next]** Add alerting on market-data-service nav_age_s > 64,800s (18 hours) and job-scheduler jobs_failed > 0 for critical scheduled jobs. [ev_3, ev_7]
  - Why: The nav-import failure at 18:03 UTC went undetected for ~10 hours because no alert was triggered on job failure or NAV staleness.
  - Verify: Inspect alerting rules to confirm active alerts on nav_age_s and job failure metrics.
- **[next]** Configure automated retry policies and dead-letter notifications in job-scheduler for nav-import. [ev_5, ev_6]
  - Why: When nav-import exited with code 1, no automated retry was scheduled, leaving the system in a stale state until the next day's run.
  - Verify: Verify job-scheduler job definition includes retry attempts (e.g. retries: 2, backoff: 15m).
- **[later]** Refactor market-data-service NAV parsing to stream or batch insert rows rather than loading the entire file into an in-memory staging table. [ev_5]
  - Why: Batch/stream processing ensures memory consumption remains bounded regardless of growth in the AMFI scheme catalog.
  - Verify: Benchmark nav-import with synthetic large files under constrained memory limits and confirm memory stays well below limits.

Cited evidence: ev_1, ev_3, ev_5, ev_6, ev_7, ev_8, ev_9, ev_14, ev_15, ev_16, ev_20
Investigation window: 2026-09-23 08:00 IST to 2026-09-23 11:00 IST
